name: Liv
verdict: A product brand of Giant Group (Giant Manufacturing), a listed Taiwanese bicycle maker (TPE: 9921). Nothing found.
note: Women's bike brand of Giant and co-title sponsor of Liv AlUla Jayco (Cyclist, 2026-07-14; The Inner Ring, 2026-08-05, 'Giant’s women’s brand Liv'). Giant Group's corporate site lists Liv among its product brands and shows the TPE: 9921 ticker (giantgroup-cycling.com, opened 2026-10-03). No state ownership, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against Giant or Liv found in the sources checked (2026-10-03).
